_meta.note: Distinct from duplicate-candidates-university.json (Finding 2's 43 pairs, found via exact-normalized_name self-join between two SEPARATE canonical_entities rows). This file's 'already_known_duplicate_supersession' group is a THIRD, different shape: ONE canonical_entities row with TWO universities rows pointing at it (already identity-consolidated, per lib/universities/canonical.ts's duplicate-supersessions.json workaround) that also happens to lack ROR. This file's 'genuine_single_row_gap' group was originally described as straightforward enrichment targets -- 4 of the 16 (both Rutgers rows, Universite de Franche-Comte, Universite Paul Sabatier Toulouse III -- see each row's own WARNING field) turned out NOT to be, on direct verification against ROR's live API. Check every row for a WARNING field before treating any of these as mechanical.

verification_status_note: Live ROR API spot-check (session of 2026-08-21, see 05-duplicate-detection-rules.md 'Verifying the recommendation itself' and its follow-up paragraph): KFUPM, HKUST, UTS, and University of Newcastle Australia (all 4 checked from this array) return clean, exact, unambiguous top matches -- safe to enrich as-is. In the genuine_single_row_gap array below: Al-Quds, Eastern Mediterranean, European University of Lefke, Near East, and Lingnan all checked clean; Rutgers (both rows) and the two French universities did not -- see their individual WARNING fields.
MAJOR_UPDATE_existing_tooling_found: scripts/university-duplicates-audit.ts (npm run audit:university-duplicates) already exists, was already run 2026-08-17/18, and its hardcoded MANUALLY_VERIFIED list already carries a live-ROR-verified id for every one of the 9 entities below (Al-Farabi Kazakh National University added late in this session -- was always in MANUALLY_VERIFIED but not originally extracted here, see its own correction_note) -- this session's own fresh ROR checks (KFUPM, HKUST, UTS, Newcastle-Australia) independently arrived at the IDENTICAL ids, cross-confirming the script's 2026-08-17 research is still correct. The gap for these 9 specifically is NOT 'needs ROR research' -- it is narrower: merge_canonical_entities() (run via --merge-verified) merges identity/aliases but does not itself write new entity_external_ids rows, so the already-known ROR id was apparently never separately applied via the acquisition pipeline for 8 of these 9 (Al-Farabi's ROR id IS already written -- see its entry). See each row's 'ror_id_already_known' field below -- sourced from the script's own MANUALLY_VERIFIED reason text, not re-derived. This does NOT apply to the 43 orphan pairs in duplicate-candidates-university.json, which do not appear anywhere in that script's 38-entry MANUALLY_VERIFIED list and remain a genuinely separate, unaddressed gap.
